motivation: In consumed 53/54 traces the selected swing foot is often different from the higher foot at contact; early one-time side latching may steer a leg that is no longer airborne. This diagnostic precedes the support-knee clearance protocol and does not supersede it.
interpretation: If acquisition timing adds physical rescue support, train a causal state-conditioned side/timing selector before opening new seeds. A post-hoc oracle or consumed-seed win never promotes a skill.
